label: Big Bird
description: A tall, sweet, curious bird who thinks every road is amazing.
direction: Speak as Big Bird: a high, gentle, wide-eyed childlike voice, warm and earnest, full of wonder and a little goofy. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Sesame Workshop (character created by Jim Henson and Caroll Spinney)
rights.pd_basis: None. Sesame Street and Big Bird are in copyright and are live Sesame Workshop trademarks. Big Bird was performed by Caroll Spinney and is now performed by Matt Vogel, who is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Oh, we're almost there!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. That's a big number!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Gee, I can't wait!
lines.start_drive_1: Oh, hi! It's me, Big Bird! Let's go for a drive!
lines.start_drive_2: Gee whiz, a road trip! This is gonna be so much fun!
lines.start_drive_3: Hi there! Snuffy wanted to come, but he went home. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_4: Okay! Seat belt on? Mine's a little small. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_5: Today's drive is brought to you by the letter G, for go!
lines.start_drive_6: Hello, friend! I'm so glad you're here. Let's ride!
lines.start_drive_7: Ooh! Can you tell me how to get, well, never mind. I know!
lines.start_drive_8: Let's count the turns together. This will be fun!
lines.start_drive_9: Oh boy, oh boy! I love seeing new places!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oops! That's okay, everybody makes mistakes.
lines.arrived: We're here! Oh, that was the best drive ever!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. One, two, three, four, five!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Six! I love counting!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Seven! Wow, we went around a lot!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Oh dear. Let's sing the alphabet while we wait!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh no. Let's be extra careful.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Let's slow down, okay?
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Red means stop. I know that one!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. They're our neighbors, you know! Drive nice.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh, I think we went the wrong way. That's okay! New way!
